summary.work_completed: Authored unit and E2E tests for FR-BRICK-004 (brick rotation in 90° increments). Unit tests cover pure rotation logic, uiStore placement-preview rotation, sceneStore placed-brick rotation, occupancy-map footprint recalculation, and RotateBrick command undo/redo. E2E tests cover the full user flow via R key.
key_findings: Tests are self-contained with inline stubs — no dependency on unimplemented source modules
Occupancy-map footprint swap (width↔depth at 90°/270°) is explicitly verified
RotateBrick command undo/redo is covered at unit level
E2E tests rely on data-testid attributes that the implementation agent must add
All three test IDs from the issue are covered: T-BE-BRICK-004-01, T-BE-BRICK-004-02, T-E2E-BRICK-004-01

human_review_required.reason: E2E tests depend on data-testid='placement-rotation-indicator', 'placed-brick-*', 'selection-indicator', 'error-overlay'. These must be present in the implementation for E2E tests to pass.

recommended_actions: Review unit tests in frontend/tests/unit/brickRotation.test.ts for correctness against the actual source implementation
Review E2E tests in frontend/tests/e2e/brickRotation.spec.ts and verify data-testid attributes match the implementation
Confirm RotateBrick command in frontend/src/engine/commands.ts supports undo/redo as tested
Verify occupancy-map footprint swap logic in frontend/src/utils/gridMath.ts matches test expectations
Check that useKeyboardShortcuts.ts dispatches rotation for both placement-preview and placed-brick contexts
